title: Vanishing of the full cotangent complex for etale ring maps
statement: Let $R\to C$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings that is etale: it is finitely presented as an algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and for every $R$-algebra $D$ and square-zero ideal $J\subseteq D$, reduction gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(C,D)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(C,D/J)$. Then its standard cotangent complex [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] is zero in $D(C)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; equivalently $H^i(L_{C/R})=0$ for every integer $i$.
